model.name: Requirement.classifyType
model.description: Icon + type resolution per ior:class subtype. Implementation touches 4 files: (1) classes.ts: BugLoader + ChangeRequestLoader (clone RequirementLoader defaults). (2) ClassRegistry constructor: register Bug + ChangeRequest loaders. (3) icons.ts: TRACE_ICONS['bug'] + TRACE_ICONS['changerequest']. (4) app.css: rb-object-item[type=bug] + [type=changerequest] color vars. (5) SCENARIO_FWD + TRACE_FWD: Bug/ChangeRequest entries = same as Requirement (['useCases']).
